scope: Evaluation-only. Live source loads, complete reference/alignment checks, and coarse manual review of 1–3 examples per source. No training rows published.

review_findings.finding: Native gold document discusses phototaxis, an indirect match to the insect/light/heat question. All 103 queries resolve their gold IDs in the matching corpus. Preserve native retrieval judgments; no fabricated negative classifications or assertion that each gold document alone fully answers the query.
Recall article on GM truck crashworthiness matches the original question, but the changed instruction explicitly excludes recall articles. Correct original/changed judgment pairing preserved.
Cancer/electrical-exposure article includes leukemia. The modified instruction explicitly excludes leukemia; matching grade changes to zero.
MERS-related article discusses possible animal carriers. Changed instruction explicitly excludes potential animal origins, matching the zero grade. All native scores, including 16, are preserved.

Two inspected sports-ethics passages address compensation, enhancement and/or diversity in the multi-part sports narrative. Both native graded qrels align with candidate IDs. All qrel query IDs resolve; unjudged candidates remain separate, never converted to grade zero.

Citation indices and native labels survive flattening. Question date is included. Source has subjective or debatable UNKNOWN/OUTDATED assignments; these views expose human category annotations rather than independently verified factual truth. Binary view explicitly asks for the native answer-support category. Answers and citation-use labels are absent from model inputs.
